value.name: Dicky pitches a money scheme
value.description: Dicky tells the assembled Cambodians that they can each give money to ten people, implying a way to collect $2,000.
evidence: Dicky -- to give YOU $200 each, and now you have your $2,000.

value.name: Karen translates for Dicky
value.description: Karen translates Dicky's pitch into Cambodian for the group.
evidence: Karen, his CAMBODIAN CRACK GIRLFRIEND AND 6 YEAR OLD SON IS NEXT TO HIM HOLDING HIS HAND LOOKING A BIT STRUNG OUT.
KAREN (DICKY'S CAMBODIAN CRACK GIRLFRIEND) Translates to Cambodian.

value.name: Dicky asks if they understand
value.description: Dicky checks whether the group understands his explanation.

value.name: Pran questions the payout
value.description: Pran asks whether everyone is really getting $200, showing suspicion about Dicky's offer.
evidence: DICKY Not everyone, just 10 a you.

value.name: BooBoo clarifies the scam
value.description: BooBoo explains that only ten lucky people will get the money, making the scheme sound like a lottery.

value.name: Group accuses Dicky of ripping them off
value.description: The Cambodian group reacts angrily, accusing Dicky of cheating them.

value.name: Dicky reframes the scheme as opportunity
value.description: Dicky denies wrongdoing and insists he is offering the group an opportunity.
evidence: DICKY No no no no. I'm givin' you an OPPORTUNITY!

value.name: Chan demands money directly
value.description: Chan challenges Dicky by demanding that he give him $200 personally.

value.name: Dicky explains the chain referral
value.description: Dicky says Chan can get the money from ten other people if he offers them the same opportunity.
evidence: DICKY You get that from TEN OTHAH PEOPLE you offah the opportunity to.

value.name: BooBoo compares scheme to white people
value.description: BooBoo defends the scam by saying white people do the same thing to other white people.
evidence: BOOBOO White people do this! To othah white people! It's what makes the world go 'round.

value.name: Dicky professes love for Cambodian people
value.description: Dicky puts his arm around Karen and declares his love for Cambodian people to calm the confrontation.
evidence: DICKY (puts an arm around Karen) I love Cambodian people!

value.name: Group angrily protests in Cambodian
value.description: The Cambodians continue yelling at Dicky in Cambodian while he remains irritated and holding onto Quackah.
evidence: They all yell in Cambodian at Dicky who looks aggravated, still holding onto Quackah.
